text: County seeks an annual actuarial valuation of its self-insured workers compensation program

citations.text: The County of Ulster is currently seeking proposals for actuarial services for the Ulster County Self-Insurance Plan which includes County Government, local municipalities, school districts, and volunteer fire fighters.
The County is seeking a qualified Actuary Firm to provide an annual actuarial valuation of the County’s self-insured workers compensation program.

citations.text: The County of Ulster is currently seeking proposals for actuarial services for the Ulster County Self-Insurance Plan which includes County Government, local municipalities, school districts, and volunteer fire fighters.
The plan provides coverage to employees of the County, 20 towns, 3 villages, 7 school districts, 26 volunteer fire districts within the County, 1 city, and Ulster County Community College.

text: The County administers the plan with its employees and a third-party administrator; the County Executive oversees it

citations.text: The administration of this plan is accomplished with County employees in conjunction with a Third-party administrator and is overseen by the County Executive.

text: The plan was established under Local Law #1 of 1979 and amended under Local Law #10 of 2008

citations.text: In accordance with the provisions of the New York State Workers’ Compensation Law, Ulster County established a pooled Self-Insurance Plan by Local Law #1 of 1979.
The law was amended under Local Law #10 of 2008.

text: The County seeks independent analysis of workers’ compensation loss reserves, including incurred-but-not-reported claims

citations.text: Workers’ Compensation Actuarial Services will consist of an independent actuarial analysis of the loss reserve (incurred but not reported) related to the Workers’ Compensation Coverage.
•Estimate of necessary reserves to include a provision for both known claims and claims that have been incurred but not reported (IBNR).

text: Provide total year-end reserves on discounted and undiscounted bases

citations.text: The study must provide an estimate of the total reserves as of the end of the year on both a discounted and undiscounted basis.

text: The actuarial work includes agency-level expected losses, two-year future loss payments, year-end unpaid liabilities, participant withdrawal liabilities, and contingencies

citations.text: •Estimate of the expected losses for the upcoming calendar year by agency.
•Estimate of the future loss payments by calendar year for the next two (2) years.
•Calculation of discounted and non-discounted unpaid liabilities at year’s end.
•Calculation for each individual participant to cover open liabilities if they withdraw from the plan.
•Anticipated and unanticipated contingencies.

text: The work includes allocating reserves or funding to individual plan participants

citations.text: •Allocation of reserves and/or funding to individual plan participants.

citations.text: Any misrepresentation or false statement related to the successful responder’s status in this regard, or any failure by the successful responder to immediately notify the County Attorney of any change in such status, shall result in immediate termination of County’s business relationship with the successful responder in addition to such other remedies as may be provided by law, in equity, pursuant to the terms and conditions of this RFP document, or the conditions of the contract, if any, resulting from this RFP.

text: If anticipated state or federal funding changes or is reduced or denied, the County is not liable for the difference

citations.text: In the event that the anticipated amount of funding changes, or is reduced or denied, in part or in full, the County, where appropriate, will not be liable to the Firm for the difference.

text: Agreement amounts may be amended to reflect actual state or federal funding after County notification

citations.text: The amounts in this Agreement will be amended to reflect the actual amounts to be paid upon notification to the County by the state and/or Federal Government, as necessary.

text: For breach of procurement representations, County may annul the agreement, recover payments, and deny further sums

citations.text: For a breach or violation of such representations or warranties, the County will have the right to annul this Agreement without liability, entitling the County to recover all monies paid hereunder, and the Firm shall neither make claim for, nor be entitled to recover any sum or sums otherwise due under this Agreement.

text: The County may submit service data, analyses, or conclusions to government agencies or a court

citations.text: The Firm understands that it may become necessary for the County to submit to governmental agencies and/or authorities, or to a court of law, part or all of the data, analyses, and/or conclusions developed as a result of its performance of these Services.

text: The County will verify whether service providers have faced adverse government action or exclusion from federal healthcare programs

citations.text: The County will also verify that entities and businesses that provide and/or perform Services for the County have not been the subject of adverse governmental actions and/or excluded from the federal healthcare programs.

text: The agreement does not create an employer-employee, agency, partnership, joint venture, or fiduciary relationship

citations.text: Nothing contained in this Agreement will be construed to create the relationship of employer and employee, principal and agent, partnership, or joint venture, or any other fiduciary relationship.

text: Unauthorized assignment makes related services uncompensated and may allow the County to terminate for cause and forfeit unpaid amounts

citations.text: Firm, its assignees, or transferees; and all monies that may become due under this Agreement shall be forfeited to the County, except so much thereof as may be necessary to pay the Firm’s employees for past Services.

text: The assignment restriction does not prevent assignment for creditors under New York Debtor and Creditor Law, subject to federal law

citations.text: The provisions of this clause shall not hinder, prevent, or affect any assignment by the Firm for the benefit of its creditors made pursuant to Article 2 of Chapter 12 of the New York Debtor and Creditor Law, except where the Federal Supremacy Clause requires otherwise.

text: The County will rely on the accuracy, competence, and completeness of the firm’s work

citations.text: The Firm is hereby given notice that the County will be relying upon the accuracy, competence, and completeness of the Firm’s performance in using the results achieved by the Firm’s performance of these Services.

text: Confidential Information includes reports, records, notes, and other materials and data developed or obtained through the services

citations.text: Confidential Information will include, but not be limited to: samples, substances and other materials, conversations, correspondence, records, notes, reports, plans, drawings, specifications and other documents in draft or final form, including any documentation or data relating to the results of any investigation, testing, sampling in laboratory or other analysis, and all conclusions, interpretations, recommendations, and/or comments relating thereto.

text: The County may inspect the firm’s office arrangements for securing Confidential Information

citations.text: The County will have the right, but not the obligation, to enter the Firm’s offices in order to inspect the arrangements of the Firm for keeping Confidential Information secure.

text: County inspection, or failure to inspect, does not relieve the firm of its confidentiality responsibilities

citations.text: The County’s inspection, or its failure to inspect, will not relieve the Firm of its responsibilities pursuant to this Article 15.

text: Disclosure is permitted for information made public independently or required by subpoena, warrant, or court order, subject to the contract’s disclosure process

citations.text: The Firm is not prohibited from disclosing portions of Confidential Information if and to the extent that: (i) such portions have become generally available to the public other than by an act or omission of the Firm, or (ii) disclosure of such portions is required by subpoena, warrant, or court order;

text: Audits may examine the source and use of funds from any source

citations.text: Such audits may include examination and review of the source and application of all funds, whether from the County, the State of New York, the Federal Government, private sources, or otherwise.

text: The County’s termination and damages remedies are nonexclusive and may be combined with other legal or contractual remedies

citations.text: The rights and remedies of the County provided herein will not be exclusive and are in addition to any other rights and remedies provided by law, in equity, or pursuant to this Agreement.

text: The firm’s liability for the County’s enforcement costs and prejudgment interest survives service completion or contract termination

citations.text: This provision shall survive completion of the Services and/or the expiration or termination of this Agreement.

text: A County waiver is valid only if expressly written by the County Executive or Director of General Services

citations.text: None of the conditions of this Agreement will be considered waived by the County unless such waiver is explicitly given in writing by the Executive or the Director of General Services.

text: A written waiver does not waive any other past or future default unless it expressly says so

citations.text: No such waiver shall be a waiver of any past or future default, breach, or modification of any of the terms or conditions of this Agreement, unless expressly stipulated in such waiver as executed by the Executive or the Director of General Services.

text: Invalidity of one contract provision does not affect the remaining provisions

citations.text: The invalidity or invalid application of any provision of this Agreement will not affect the validity of any other provision, or the application of any other provision of this Agreement.

text: The firm may not make claims against County officers, agents, or employees for acts or omissions connected with the agreement
